meta_title: Indian Passport Photo Size (3.5×4.5 cm) & Rules | Resize-It
meta_description: Indian passport photos are 4.5 × 3.5 cm in colour with a plain white background, full frontal face and both ears visible. Find out when you need one and crop yours free.
h1: Indian Passport Photo Size and Requirements
subtitle: Crop your photo to 4.5 × 3.5 cm on a white background, checked against Passport Seva guidance.

tool_workspace.description: Upload a photo to crop it to the official size. Everything is processed in your browser; nothing is uploaded.

rows.label: Colour
rows.value: Colour photograph. Black-and-white photos and computer printouts are not accepted.

rows.label: Pose
rows.value: Frontal view of the full face with both ears visible and a natural expression

rows.label: Clothing
rows.value: Dark-coloured clothing is advised so you stand out from the white background

rows.label: How many
rows.value: Two colour photographs when a photo is required

rows.label: When you need one
rows.value: Not needed at a Passport Seva Kendra (PSK) or Post Office PSK, where your photo is taken on the spot. Needed for applications at other collection centres.

notes: Applying at a Passport Seva Kendra or Post Office Passport Seva Kendra? You do not need to bring a photo; it is captured during your appointment.
The correct size for Indian passports is 4.5 × 3.5 cm. The 2 × 2 inch (51 × 51 mm) square size is a US standard, not an Indian passport size.
Print the PDF sheet at 100% scale on photo paper. Computer printouts on plain paper are rejected.
Keep your face straight to the camera with both ears showing and no hair over your face.
requirements.checked: Checked against these sources in November 2026. Rules change, so confirm on the official page before you apply.

how_to.title: How to make a Indian passport photo
how_to.step1_text: Stand in front of a plain background in even light and have someone else take the photo at eye level. Follow the Indian rules below.
how_to.step2_text: Choose the photo. It is processed in your browser and never uploaded to a server.
how_to.step3_text: Drag the frame to centre your face and use Zoom until your head fills the frame to the size the rules require.
how_to.step4_text: Download the PDF sheet and print it at actual size (100%, no "fit to page") on photo paper, then cut out the photos.

items.q: What is the Indian passport photo size?
items.a: 4.5 cm high by 3.5 cm wide (35 × 45 mm), in colour, with a plain white background.

items.q: Do I need to bring a photo to the Passport Seva Kendra?
items.a: No. Photos are not required for applications submitted at a PSK or Post Office PSK; your photo is taken there. You need printed photos for applications at other collection centres.

items.q: Is a 2 × 2 inch photo valid for an Indian passport?
items.a: No. 2 × 2 inch (51 × 51 mm) is the US passport size. Indian passport photos are 4.5 × 3.5 cm.

items.q: Can I wear glasses in my Indian passport photo?
items.a: Tinted glasses are not accepted. Keep your full face, both ears and eyes clearly visible.
